import os, time
import nanosurf

# Initialize SPM application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
app = spm.application
scan = app.Scan
zctrl = app.ZController

# Set common scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # time per line (s)
scan.Points = 256  # points per line (default high quality)
scan.Lines = 32   # lines per frame as requested
scan.CenterPosX = 0.0
scan.CenterPosY = 0.0
scan.SlopeX = 0.0
scan.SlopeY = 0.0
scan.Overscan = 0
scan.Rotation = 0

# Set PID gains
zctrl.PGain = 100
zctrl.IGain = 6000
zctrl.DGain = 10

# Directory to store images
out_dir = r"C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/corral/corral/tasks/afm/src/afm/gpt_4o_oss/enviroment/tasks_1_1/scans"
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

rms_values = []
paths = []

for i in range(1, 4):
    # Start scan (blocking call assumed)
    scan.Start()  # this blocks until scan finishes
    # Save image – the API typically provides a method to get the last image object
    img = scan.GetLastImage()
    img_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"scan_{i}.nid")
    img.Save(img_path)
    paths.append(img_path)
    # Analyze RMS roughness
    analysis = Image_Analyzer(path=img_path, calculate_rms_roughness=True)
    rms = analysis.get('rms_roughness') or analysis.get('Rq') or analysis.get('rms')
    rms_values.append(rms)
    # Small pause before next scan
    time.sleep(0.5)

# Clean up SPM object
del spm

# Output results as a dictionary
result = {
    "rms_roughness_1": rms_values[0],
    "path_1": paths[0],
    "rms_roughness_2": rms_values[1],
    "path_2": paths[1],
    "rms_roughness_3": rms_values[2],
    "path_3": paths[2]
}
print(result)
"
}"}
